title: REITs in India: How Real Estate Investment Trusts Work, Tax, Risks and Listed REITs
seoTitle: REITs in India: How They Work, Tax and Listed REITs
seoDescription: How SEBI-regulated REITs work in India, the six listed REITs, minimum investment, how payouts are taxed, the risks, and REITs vs buying property.
excerpt: A plain guide to REITs in India: how SEBI-regulated real estate investment trusts work, the listed REITs as of late 2026, how little you need to invest, how interest, dividend and capital gains are taxed, the risks, and how a REIT compares with buying property.
